name: Crash Zoom
tagline: A dramatic crash zoom straight into your eyes.
subject: the person
motion: {subject} slowly turns to look straight into the lens. The camera suddenly crash-zooms in at high speed toward their eyes, motion blur streaking the edges, stopping hard on an extreme close-up of one eye as the iris catches a glint of light. Dramatic film lighting.
sound: a sharp rising whoosh and a heavy cinematic impact boom
author: Conjure
